# Zava Forward operations
Source-only candidate, not operational acceptance. Select a window below. No telemetry, missing approvals or query/access errors mean **Insufficient / Blocked**, never healthy or zero cost. Application Insights instrumentation and availability tests are not provisioned by this workbook. Request success is not availability. Proposed ADR 0001 targets are unmeasured, not approved SLO attainment.

[Operator runbooks and acceptance gaps](https://github.com/jmservera/ama/blob/main/infra/monitoring-runbooks.md). New job/IoT alert candidates are disabled by default; check actual deployed rule status separately. No poison-queue, AI-limit or RAI-harm aggregate alert is installed by this candidate.

## Requests, errors and latency
Counts use Application Insights ItemCount sampling weights; p95 is weighted request DurationMs, not average platform latency or end-to-end scenario completion. Invalid/missing fields are excluded and counted. The result names the selected window and as-of UTC. Empty/absent tables return Insufficient; permission, schema or query failures remain **Blocked** even if a panel shows an error. Query source validation is not service execution.

content.title: Sample-weighted requests, failures and p95 (ms)
content.query: let samples = union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, _ResourceId:string, ItemCount:int, Success:bool, DurationMs:real)[]), AppRequests | project TimeGenerated, _ResourceId, ItemCount, Success, DurationMs; samples | where _ResourceId =~ '__APP_INSIGHTS_ID__' and TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end}) | extend Valid = isnotnull(ItemCount) and ItemCount > 0 and isnotnull(Success) and isnotnull(DurationMs) and DurationMs >= 0 | summarize ObservedRows=count(), InvalidRows=countif(not(Valid)), WeightedRequests=sumif(ItemCount, Valid), WeightedFailures=sumif(ItemCount, Valid and Success == false), P95Ms=percentilew(iff(Valid, DurationMs, real(null)), iff(Valid, ItemCount, 0), 95) | extend Status=iff(WeightedRequests > 0 and InvalidRows == 0, 'Observed samples; not SLO acceptance', 'Insufficient'), FailurePercent=iff(WeightedRequests > 0, 100.0 * WeightedFailures / WeightedRequests, real(null)), P95Ms=iff(WeightedRequests > 0, P95Ms, real(null)), WeightedRequests=iff(WeightedRequests > 0, WeightedRequests, long(null)), WeightedFailures=iff(WeightedRequests > 0, WeightedFailures, long(null)), WindowStart={TimeRange:start}, WindowEnd={TimeRange:end}, AsOfUtc=now() | project Status, WindowStart, WindowEnd, AsOfUtc, ObservedRows, InvalidRows, WeightedRequests, WeightedFailures, FailurePercent, P95Ms

content.title: Availability-test samples (not request success or a production SLO)
content.query: let samples = union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, _ResourceId:string, ItemCount:int, Success:bool)[]), AppAvailabilityResults | project TimeGenerated, _ResourceId, ItemCount, Success; samples | where _ResourceId =~ '__APP_INSIGHTS_ID__' and TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end}) | extend Valid = isnotnull(ItemCount) and ItemCount > 0 and isnotnull(Success) | summarize ObservedRows=count(), InvalidRows=countif(not(Valid)), WeightedTests=sumif(ItemCount, Valid), WeightedSuccessfulTests=sumif(ItemCount, Valid and Success == true) | extend Status=iff(WeightedTests > 0 and InvalidRows == 0, 'Observed tests; not SLO acceptance', 'Insufficient'), TestSuccessPercent=iff(WeightedTests > 0, 100.0 * WeightedSuccessfulTests / WeightedTests, real(null)), WeightedTests=iff(WeightedTests > 0, WeightedTests, long(null)), WeightedSuccessfulTests=iff(WeightedTests > 0, WeightedSuccessfulTests, long(null)), WindowStart={TimeRange:start}, WindowEnd={TimeRange:end}, AsOfUtc=now() | project Status, WindowStart, WindowEnd, AsOfUtc, ObservedRows, InvalidRows, WeightedTests, WeightedSuccessfulTests, TestSuccessPercent

## Cost against budget: Unknown / unreconciled
Configured resource-group monthly budget: **__MONTHLY_BUDGET__ in the billing currency**, resource `__BUDGET_NAME__`. This is a template setting, not an observed bill, approved new allocation or remaining headroom. Actual spend: **Unknown**. Forecast: **Unknown**. Variance against budget: **Unknown / unreconciled**. Open the resource group's Cost Management > Cost analysis and Budgets in the Azure portal; record the exact same calendar month, scope, billing currency, retrieval date and billing record before any comparison.

The existing budget sends notifications above **80% actual** and **100% forecast**. Notification is **not a hard cap** and does not stop workloads, dispatch or billing. Delayed cost records do not establish headroom. [Budget response](https://github.com/jmservera/ama/blob/main/infra/monitoring-runbooks.md#budget-actual80).

content.title: Azure cost record against the configured budget
content.query: print ConfiguredMonthlyBudget=__MONTHLY_BUDGET__, BudgetResource='__BUDGET_NAME__', AzureActualCost='Unknown', AzureForecast='Unknown', VarianceAgainstBudget='Unreconciled', Basis='Template budget; the Azure billing record for the same month, scope and currency is the financial source and is not connected', WindowStart={TimeRange:start}, WindowEnd={TimeRange:end}, AsOfUtc=now()

content.title: Metered AI usage by capability and month beside the Azure cost record
content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs | where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end}) and Log has 'AI_USAGE' | parse Log with * 'AI_USAGE capability=' Capability ' period=' Period ' calls=' Calls:long ' tokens=' Tokens:long ' usage=' UsageState ' outcome=' Outcome | where isnotempty(Capability) and isnotempty(Period) | summarize MeteredCalls=sum(Calls), MeteredTokens=sumif(Tokens, UsageState == 'known'), CallsWithUnknownUsage=sumif(Calls, UsageState != 'known'), NonReturnedCalls=sumif(Calls, Outcome != 'returned') by Capability, Period | extend MeteredCharge='Unknown (no dated price in the console signal)', AzureCostRecord='Unknown (billing record not connected)', UnreconciledVariance='Unreconciled, not zero', ConfiguredMonthlyBudget=__MONTHLY_BUDGET__, Basis='Non-authoritative console aggregate; may include work later rolled back; the assistant ledger and Azure billing record are the sources', AsOfUtc=now() | order by Period asc, Capability asc
content.noDataMessage: Insufficient: no AI_USAGE telemetry in the selected window. This is not zero usage or zero cost.

content.title: Unreconciled AI cost variance by period (metered minus billed)
content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs | where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end}) and Log has 'AI_USAGE' | parse Log with * 'AI_USAGE capability=' Capability ' period=' Period ' calls=' Calls:long ' tokens=' Tokens:long ' usage=' UsageState ' outcome=' Outcome | extend Attributed = isnotempty(Capability) and isnotempty(Period) | summarize CapabilitiesSeen=dcountif(Capability, Attributed), AttributedCalls=sumif(Calls, Attributed), UnattributedUsageRows=countif(not(Attributed)), CallsWithUnknownUsage=sumif(Calls, Attributed and UsageState != 'known') by Period | extend AzureCostRows=long(0), MeteredCost=real(null), BilledCost=real(null), Variance=real(null), UnreconciledVariance=iff(UnattributedUsageRows > 0 or AzureCostRows == 0, 'Unreconciled, not zero', 'Compare metered and billed cost'), Basis='Metered minus billed is unknown until a dated price and the Azure billing record for the same scope, month and currency are connected; missing cost rows are shown, not zero', AsOfUtc=now() | order by Period asc
content.noDataMessage: Insufficient: no AI_USAGE telemetry in the selected window. This is not zero usage, zero cost or reconciled variance.

content.title: HTTP and job operation errors and p95 latency (ms) by operation
content.query: let samples = union isfuzzy=true (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime, _ResourceId:string, ItemCount:int, Success:bool, DurationMs:real, OperationName:string)[]), AppRequests | project TimeGenerated, _ResourceId, ItemCount, Success, DurationMs, OperationName; samples | where _ResourceId =~ '__APP_INSIGHTS_ID__' and TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end}) | where isnotnull(ItemCount) and ItemCount > 0 and isnotnull(Success) and isnotnull(DurationMs) and DurationMs >= 0 | summarize WeightedOperations=sum(ItemCount), WeightedErrors=sumif(ItemCount, Success == false), P95Ms=percentilew(DurationMs, ItemCount, 95) by OperationName | extend ErrorPercent=100.0 * WeightedErrors / WeightedOperations, Status='Observed samples; not SLO acceptance', AsOfUtc=now() | order by ErrorPercent desc
content.noDataMessage: Insufficient: no request telemetry in the selected window. This is not zero errors.

content.title: AI limit holds by reason and month
content.query: ContainerAppConsoleLogs | where TimeGenerated between ({TimeRange:start} .. {TimeRange:end}) and Log has 'AI_LIMIT_BREACH' | parse Log with * 'AI_LIMIT_BREACH reason=' Reason ' route=' Route | where isnotempty(Reason) | summarize Holds=count() by Reason, Period=format_datetime(TimeGenerated, 'yyyy-MM') | extend Owner='Competent task owner and Digital service owner, appointment pending', Runbook='infra/monitoring-runbooks.md#ai-limits', AsOfUtc=now() | order by Period asc, Reason asc
content.noDataMessage: Insufficient: no AI_LIMIT_BREACH telemetry in the selected window. This is not proof that limits held.

## AI consumption and harm: Blocked / insufficient
| Surface | Capability and period | Current evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Calls and tokens by capability and month | Panel above, from the console `AI_USAGE` marker | Insufficient when absent; a non-authoritative aggregate, not the ledger |
| Azure cost record / dated versioned price | Not connected | Unknown; no consumption-to-currency conversion |
| Metered-to-billing variance | Same scope/month/currency not established | Unknown / unreconciled, not zero |
| Calls/tokens/budget/expiry alerts | Candidate rule and holds panel above | Blocked until owner, limits and signal are approved; the rule is disabled by default |
| Harm/quality/disparity/review burden | Task/release/cohort/window/denominator not supplied | Insufficient; approval rate is not safety evidence |
| Disabled task monitoring | Named owner/manual route not verified | Blocked; inspect existing audit/continuity surfaces |

Use the existing protected SQL audit/report and incident-control paths, not a new telemetry store. Do not copy prompts, source text, sensitive reasons, tokens, identities, readings or chat here. Human threshold/owner approval, repeat-event/window reconciliation and an owned suspension drill remain required. Constructed fixtures are synthetic, not actual approval. [AI limit gap](https://github.com/jmservera/ama/blob/main/infra/monitoring-runbooks.md#ai-limits) and [incident response](https://github.com/jmservera/ama/blob/main/infra/monitoring-runbooks.md#rai-harm).
